description.value:
Frequency once per day

As a living hologram, you know how to blend in with other forms of light and how light can be used to your advantage to distract or misdirect those who aren't as experienced manipulating light. These lived experiences have made you aware of the little clues that can give away the position of someone trying to avoid notice. You heighten your senses, gaining the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Truesight] spell.
